'''hobbie_jss Which way did he go''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[hobbie_jss]]
* '''Published:''' 10 April 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Strategy:''' Local Uprising
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 LU hobbie_jss LS 2002 Whichway.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a misdirection deck. Suck the opponent in a then smack him on the side of the head!

== Strategy ==

Once they see the objective played they should pull out the No Escape and Leave Them To Me Defensive Shields, possibly the Wipe Them Out as well. If not, they might grab your Nar Shadda once they see you play it.

If so, you have them. Play your numbers and anger, fear, aggressions and watch them weep.

Retrieve with 3 different scenerios, but not too much because he might play Secret Plans.

Tell me what you think.
